items.title: IBM Integration Intelligence Hub on AWS: Enterprise context for AI coding
items.summary: Developers increasingly use AI coding assistants to build and modify enterprise integrations. To do this work well, an assistant needs two things: the specialized tools and skills that integration products require, and information about what an organization has already built, what can be reused, and how existing assets relate to one another.
